terra.problem: Calling the pursuit of chaff silly makes the action Job asks about God doing the joke.
“God will” changes Job’s present-tense statement into a future one.
“God will” changes Job’s present-tense statement into a future one.
Saying Job sees a person’s life as “that quick” assigns it the few-day length of the counter-flower example. Job gives no such duration.
The flower patch and “No bouquet in this verse” add little beyond repeating the answer; the explanation is flat.
The explanation gives rest but omits the other part of the correct answer: Job asks God to look away.
“Bounce back that fast” assigns a speed to the tree’s budding that Job does not give.
Saying the tree does not get any pruning asserts something the passage does not say.
“No one is keeping track” goes beyond Job’s statement that God would not keep track of his sin.
Saying the bagged transgression is then covered over adds a sequence and combines the two images. Job says God would cover his iniquity.
The explanation repeats the contrast without adding insight or personality, ending with the flat “Covered means covered.”
“I’ll leave the jokes out of it” comments on how Papa Dorin tells the passage.
“Slow and steady” assigns a pace to the destruction of hope that Job does not state.
